name: Thundering Palm of the Nine Heavens
description: The signature art of the lost Jadestep Sect. The palm gathers the weight of nine overlapping skies and sets it down, once, on a single point. Thunder follows — sometimes the air itself; sometimes the opponent's bones.

name: Cloudtread Footwork
description: A higher octave of cloud-step. Each footfall is a small decision not to be where the blow is aimed. The body becomes cheap; the stance becomes expensive.

name: Ironbark Stance
description: An old mountain-guard stance. The legs are roots, the spine is a trunk; the hands do not move until they must. A blow that lands slides off like rain down bark.

name: Skyweaver's Veil
description: A lattice of qi drawn across the opponent's senses like weather. For two breaths, they forget which way is up. If the caster's footwork is good, they never remember in time.

name: Stormcall Bolt
description: A bolt of pale qi wound tight as lightning and released along the length of a weapon or limb. What it does not burn, it makes bleed.
